sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (White River NF '2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates')

values.note: 16 back-in sites for RVs or tents and 9 walk-in tent sites (site 18 fully accessible). 'Parking spurs for campsites are up to 35 feet long. RVs longer than this would not fit in this campground.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/gore-creek-campground (Facilities: 'The campground offers 16 back-in sites, eight walk-in tent sites; number 18 is a fully accessible tent site ... Parking spurs for campsites are up to 35 feet long') + recreation.gov description (same) + rec.gov catalog (16 STANDARD NONELECTRIC at 35 ft, 9 TENT ONLY) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('25/40'' sites/max length), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: rec.gov catalog (all sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC or TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/gore-creek-campground ('Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: No drinking water; bear-resistant food lockers at each site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/gore-creek-campground (Restrooms 'Vault Toilets'; Water 'Potable water is not available at this site'; 'bear-resistant food lockers') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (Water 'N'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 2026 estimated dates; the forest says opening dates can shift with the weather.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates ... These are estimated opening dates': Gore Creek CG season '5/20-10/2'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Run by the concessionaire American Land & Leisure (customer service 801-226-3564). Reservations close 2 days before arrival. The site must be occupied the first night and is held until 11 a.m. the next day. One RV with tow per site; an extra vehicle pays a nightly fee at the campground. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234794 (rule reservationCutOff 2; notices: 'Campers must occupy the site the first night', 'Reserved Sites will be held until check out time (ELEVEN) the day following your arrival date', 'One RV with tow per single site', 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564 or Help.WhiteRiver.HolyCross@AmericanLL.com') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (Rec.gov or FCFS: 'R'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $29 a night (2026 and 2027 rate tables); extra vehicle charged per night at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234794/rates (2026-05-20 to 2026-10-01 and 2027 Peak: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/gore-creek-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night'), read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234794 (notice 'Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only'), read 2026-10-27

note: Eagle-Holy Cross RD, East Vail (White River NF): forested, along Gore Creek near the Eagles Nest Wilderness boundary, at the west end of the paved Vail Pass/Tenmile Canyon recreation trail. Off I-70 exit 180 on Bighorn Road, just before the road-closure gate. --Claude
summary: FS page + WRNF 2026 operating-dates table + recreation.gov: confirmed 25 sites, 35-ft max (FS page), no electric, $29 (rec.gov 2026/2027), reservable on rec.gov. Added back-in only, no water hookup or drinking water, vault toilets, season May 20 - Oct 2 (2026 estimate), concessionaire and booking rules, 2-day cutoff, senior discount. No alerts or closures for Gore Creek or Bighorn Road; the hard-sided-camper order of June 2026 has been rescinded. Note rewritten.
